title: warehouse-sync SyncConfig
description: Declarative definition of one source-table → warehouse-table replication job.

name.description: Human-readable name (used in logs and UI).

sync_id.description: Stable identifier — used as PK in state store. snake_case.

version.description: SemVer of this config. Bump on schema-relevant changes.

type.description: Source type discriminator — resolved via ServiceLoader. Built-in: postgres, mysql (stub), debezium-kafka (stub).

connection.description: Connection params. Prefer *_env fields so secrets never live in config files.

columns.description: Whitelist of columns to sync. Empty/missing = all columns.

primary_key.description: Ordered PK columns. Required for merge mode.

incremental_column.description: Column used as the watermark (e.g. updated_at, id). Required for append_only + merge; ignored for full_replace.

incremental_column_type.description: Wire type of the incremental column. Determines watermark comparison + storage.

mode.description: Write mode. append_only = each batch is appended; merge = Iceberg MERGE INTO on PK; full_replace = stage to temp table then swap.

table_name.description: Fully-qualified warehouse table (namespace.table). Created if it does not exist.

partition_by.description: Partition columns for the Iceberg table.

sort_by.description: Sort-order columns for the Iceberg table.

cadence.description: Duration string ('30s', '5m', '1h'). Consumed by `serve` daemon; ignored by one-shot `run`.

batch_size.description: Max rows per LIMIT clause. Runs loop until fewer than batch_size rows returned.

full_refresh_cadence.description: Optional: how often to run a full-replace snapshot even on merge/append tables (catches deletes).

watermark_lag_seconds.description: For timestamp watermarks: don't read rows younger than N seconds (avoid racing in-flight commits).
